about_the_game:
The Witch's Bakery is a cozy narrative Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris. She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal their emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!

You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

  • Daytime, where Lunne works in the bakery and helps customers through their troubles with a little magic.

  • Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled hearts.

  • Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!

Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to get to know them, buy books for new recipes, etc.

The above example is "Le Quai des Bouquinistes" located in the 6th arrondissement of Paris! This place is known for its book sellers and its collectors of various entertainment goods, like vinyls, posters, old magazines... But also, of course, for the beautiful Notre-Dame.

Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY

For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the Heart's Cradle.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

ABOUT SUNNY LAB

We are an indie team of experienced developers from France! We have gathered to create hopeful stories, filled with lovable characters, happy smiles and deep emotional journeys. We are always reachable on our socials @SunnyLabGames!

We are so happy to share our first game "The Witch's Bakery" with you! We are still at the beginning of production and we'll be sharing all our progress with you! Feel free to ask us any question!

THE WITCH'S BAKERY DISCORD SERVER

Join our community of bakers on The Witch's Bakery Discord! It’s the best place to find all the latest news regarding the game and where you can find a community of likeminded people to chat to. You can find the link to join the server in the FAQ pinned in the Steam Discussions page!
